h: Simi kneels before Oba of Benin at his 10th coronation anniversary
p: Singer Simi reportedly performed at the grand finale of Oba Ewuare II's 10th coronation anniversary in Benin. Her gesture of kneeling before the monarch and greeting his queens drew reactions online.
body: Singer Simi has drawn attention online after performing at the grand finale of the 10th coronation anniversary of the Oba of Benin, Oba Ewuare II, at the Benin Royal Palace on Saturday, 21 November 2026.
At the event, Simi reportedly went down on her knees before the monarch in a show of respect and cultural acknowledgement. She also took time to greet the queens present at the event.
Videos of the moment were shared widely and drew reactions online.
The evening combined live music with Benin royal tradition. The anniversary marked ten years since Oba Ewuare II ascended the throne of the ancient Benin Kingdom.
more: Simi performed at the Benin Royal Palace.
She knelt before the Oba and greeted his queens.
The event marked the Oba's 10 years on the throne.
